title: Running Commentary on Torah 6 — Call Joshua
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 6 — קרא את יהושע
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Direct line-by-line gloss of the Rebbe's text.

beginner.en: Torah 6 opens with the pasuk it will elucidate: **"Vayomer Hashem el Moshe, **kra es Yehoshua**, v'hisyatzvu ba'ohel mo'ed va'atzavenu"** — 'And Hashem said to Moshe: call Yehoshua, and station yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, and I will command him' (Devarim 31:14). The whole Torah will land on a precise reading of this verse: **Moshe** as the upper point of the alef, **Yehoshua** as the lower point, **ohel mo'ed** as the vav connecting them — and the moment of the hishtalshelus (cascading transition) is the moment of 'va'atzavenu' — **I, Myself, will command him**.

intermediate.en: Pasuk base: **"Vayomer Hashem el Moshe, kra es Yehoshua, v'hisyatzvu ba'ohel mo'ed va'atzavenu"** (Dev 31:14). The whole Torah will land on a precise reading: **Moshe** = upper point of alef (keter); **Yehoshua** = lower point (chirik); **ohel mo'ed** = vav connecting them. The pivot: *va'atzavenu* — **I, Myself**, command him.
intermediate.he: פסוק־יסוד: **"וַיֹּאמֶר ה' אֶל מֹשֶׁה: קְרָא אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְהִתְיַצְּבוּ בְּאֹהֶל מוֹעֵד וַאֲצַוֶּנּוּ"** (דב' לא, יד). התורה תנחת על קריאה מדויקת: **משה** = נקודה עליונה של האל"ף (כתר); **יהושע** = נקודה תחתונה (חיריק); **אוהל מועד** = ו' המחברת ביניהן. הציר: "ואצונו" — **אני בעצמי**.

scholarly.he: פסוק היסוד: "ויאמר ה' אל משה קרא את יהושע והתיצבו באהל מועד ואצונו" (דב' לא, יד). הקריאה: משה—נקוד' עליונה (כתר); יהושע—תחתונה (חיריק); האוהל—הו"ו המחברת.

beginner.en: The opening principle. **"Every man must diminish in his own kavod (honor) and increase in the kavod ha'Makom (Hashem's honor)"** (cf. Tikkunei Zohar tikkun 13; Midrash Rabbah Bamidbar 4). Why? **"One who pursues after kavod does not merit to **kavod Elokim** but to **kavod melachim** — 'kvod melachim chakor davar' (Mishlei 25:2) — and everyone investigates him and asks: 'Who is this and who is that, that they give him such honor?' — and they dispute him, saying he isn't worthy."** By contrast: **"One who **flees** from kavod — who diminishes in his own honor and increases in kavod ha'Makom — merits to kavod Elokim, and then no one investigates whether he is worthy. Of him it is said: **'kvod Elokim haster davar'"** (Mishlei 25:2 — same verse, second half) — 'the honor of God is to conceal a matter' — it is **forbidden** to investigate this kavod.

intermediate.en: **"Every man must diminish his own kavod and increase kavod ha'Makom"** (Tik' Zohar 13; BaMR 4). Pursuing kavod → **kavod melachim** — "kvod melachim chakor davar" (Mishlei 25:2); everyone investigates and disputes him. Fleeing kavod → **kavod Elokim** — "kvod Elokim haster davar" (same verse, second half); forbidden to investigate.
intermediate.he: **"כל אדם ימעט בכבוד עצמו וירבה בכבוד המקום"** (תק"ז יג; בר"מ ד). רודף־כבוד → **כבוד מלכים** — "כבוד מלכים חקור דבר" (מש' כה, ב); הכל חוקרים וחולקים עליו. בורח־מכבוד → **כבוד אלוהים** — "כבוד אלוהים הסתר דבר" (המשך הפסוק); אסור לחקור.

scholarly.he: סעיף א. "ימעט בכבוד עצמו וירבה בכבוד המקום" (תק"ז יג; בר"מ ד). כבוד מלכים — חקור (מש' כה, ב); כבוד אלהים — הסתר (שם).

beginner.en: **"And it is impossible to merit this kavod except through **teshuvah**. And the essence of teshuvah is — when he hears his own disgrace, he is silent and quiet."** Why silence specifically? **"'Leis kavod bela kaf'"** — 'there is no *kavod* without a kaf' (Zohar Pinchas 255a). **"And the kaf is **keter**"** (ibid., and Tikkunim) — the letter kaf's very shape is a crown. **"Aspect of **Ehyeh**, aspect of teshuvah — because **'Ehyeh da **ana zamin l'mehevei**'** — 'Ehyeh — I Am, that is: I am ready to be' (Zohar)."** Reading: **"Before teshuvah, a person has no real *havayah* (existence) — as if he has not yet come into being in the world** — for 'better for him not to have been created than to have been created' (Eruvin 13b). When he comes to purify and do teshuvah, he enters the aspect of **Ehyeh** — **'ana zamin l'mehevei,' I am ready to be.** This is keter, because **keter = lashon hamtanah (waiting)** — teshuvah (cf. Yoma 38b-39a: **'haba l'taher mesayin lo'** — 'one who comes to purify is helped' — parable of one coming to buy balsam, they say 'wait'...).

intermediate.en: **Essence of teshuvah = silence when disgraced.** Why silence? **"Leis kavod bela kaf"** — no *kavod* without the kaf (Zohar Pinchas 255a) — and **kaf = keter = Ehyeh = teshuvah**: **"Ehyeh da ana zamin l'mehevei"** (I-Am = I-am-ready-to-be). Before teshuvah, no real havayah ("better not to have been created," Eruvin 13b); teshuvah begins the *coming-into-being*. **Keter = hamtanah** (waiting) — cf. **"haba l'taher mesayin lo"** (Yoma 38b-39a, parable of the balsam-buyer).
intermediate.he: **עיקר התשובה = שתיקה בעת בזיון.** למה דוקא שתיקה? **"לית כבוד בלא כ"ף"** (זוהר פנחס רנה:) — וה**כ"ף = כתר = אהיה = תשובה**: **"אהיה, דא אנא זמין למהוי"** (אהיה = אני־מוכן־להיות). קודם תשובה אין לו הוויה ("טוב לו שלא נברא", עיר' יג:); התשובה היא ההיווצרות עצמה. **כתר = המתנה** — "הבא לטהר מסייעין לו" (יומא לח:–לט., משל קונה־האפרסמון).

scholarly.he: סעיף ב. עיקר תשובה — שתיקה בבזיון. "לית כבוד בלא כ"ף" (זוה"ק פנחס רנה:); הכ"ף = כתר = אהיה ("אנא זמין למהוי") = תשובה. "כתר" = המתנה (יומא לח:–לט., "הבא ליטהר מסייעין לו").

beginner.en: The Rebbe inserts a precise kabbalistic note. **"*Peirush*: because the **achorayim** (back-side) of the Name **Ehyeh** is **gematria dam** (blood), as brought. That is: when one writes the Name 'backwards' — **aleph; aleph-heh; aleph-heh-yud; aleph-heh-yud-heh** — returning each time to the back — it is in gematria **dam**."** The arithmetic: 1 + 6 + 16 + 21 = 44. (Aleph=1; Aleph+Heh=1+5=6; Aleph+Heh+Yud=1+5+10=16; Aleph+Heh+Yud+Heh=1+5+10+5=21. Sum = 44 = **דם**.) **"And this is the aspect of the **returning and concealing of the face of Ehyeh**, that rises to **dam**."** Sin turns the face of Ehyeh inward; what remains visible from the back is *dam*. The tikkun will be to turn *dam* into *dom* (silence).

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: achorayim of **Ehyeh** = **dam** (gematria). Spelled cumulatively: א=1 + אה=6 + אהי=16 + אהיה=21 = 44 = **דם**. The hidden face of Ehyeh presents as dam; tikkun will be to flip dam → dom.
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: אחוריים של **אהי"ה** = **דם** (גימטריה). צירוף מצטבר: א=1 + אה=6 + אהי=16 + אהיה=21 = 44 = **דם**. הסתר פני אהי"ה מוצג כ"דם"; התיקון — להפוך דם לדום.

scholarly.he: אחוריים של אהי"ה במילוי = דם (1+6+16+21=44). הסתר פני אהי"ה = דם.

beginner.en: **"And the tikkun for this: to turn **dam** into **dom** (silence) — to be from those who hear their reproach and do not reply, and who do not scrutinize the disgrace to his honor."** When he fulfills *dom l'Hashem*, Hashem responds: **"'Dom l'Hashem v'hischolel lo v'hu yapeil lecha chalalim'"** (Tehillim 37:7, as Chazal expounded Gittin 7a) — 'be silent to Hashem and wait for Him, and He will fell for you corpses (**chalalim**).' The Rebbe reads *chalalim* anatomically: **"'v'libi chalal b'kirbi'"** (Tehillim 109:22) — **the blood in the left chamber of the heart is diminished."** And **"this is the aspect of **zeviches ha'yetzer ha'ra** (slaughtering the evil inclination) — and by this one merits kavod Elokim — as it is written: **'zevach todah yechabdanenu'** (Tehillim 50:23), and Chazal expounded this on zeviches ha'yetzer ha'ra"** (Sanhedrin 43b).

intermediate.en: **Tikkun: turn dam → dom (silence).** Hear reproach, don't reply. Then Hashem **"dom l'Hashem...v'hu yapeil lecha chalalim"** (Teh 37:7, Gittin 7a). **Chalalim** read anatomically: **"v'libi chalal b'kirbi"** (Teh 109:22) — blood in the *left chamber* of the heart diminished = **zeviches ha'yetzer ha'ra**. → **"zevach todah yechabdanenu"** (Teh 50:23, Sanh 43b).
intermediate.he: **התיקון: הפוך דם לדום (שתיקה).** שומע חרפתו ושותק. אז ה' — **"דום לה'... והוא יפיל לך חללים"** (תה' לז, ז; גיטין ז.). **חללים** אנטומי: **"ולבי חלל בקרבי"** (תה' קט, כב) — הדם בחלל השמאלי מתמעט = **זביחת היצר הרע**. → **"זבח תודה יכבדנני"** (תה' נ, כג; סנה' מג:).

scholarly.he: הפיכת דם לדום (שתיקה): "דום לה'... והוא יפיל לך חללים" (תה' לז, ז; גיטין ז.); "ולבי חלל בקרבי" (תה' קט, כב) — המעטת הדם בחלל השמאלי = זביחת היצה"ר (תה' נ, כג; סנה' מג:).

beginner.en: **"And one must hold always to the middah of teshuvah"** — because **"'mi yomar zikiti libi, tahrti mei'chatasi'"** — 'who can say, I have purified my heart, I am clean from my sin' (Mishlei 20:9)? **"For at the moment a person says 'chatasi, avisi, pashati' — even that cannot be said with a pure heart without ulterior motive."** Brilliant reading: the very act of confession can itself be tainted by pride (*I am confessing so piously*). **"Therefore one must do teshuvah **on the first teshuvah** — i.e., on the 'chatasi, avisi, pashati' that he said."** Proof-text: **"'bi'sfasav kibduni'"** — 'they honor Me with their lips' (Yeshayahu 29:13) — because one merits kavod Hashem by teshuvah — **"'v'libo richak mimeni'"** — 'but their heart is far from Me' — i.e., the teshuvah itself needs teshuvah.

intermediate.en: **Hold always to teshuvah.** Why? **"Mi yomar zikiti libi"** (Mishlei 20:9) — no one can say *chatasi, avisi, pashati* without some pnias (hidden motive). So: **teshuvah on the first teshuvah** — on the very chatasi-avisi-pashati spoken. **"Bi'sfasav kibduni"** (Yesh 29:13) — merits kavod by teshuvah — **"v'libo richak mimeni"** — even that teshuvah needs teshuvah.
intermediate.he: **החזק תמיד במידת התשובה.** למה? **"מי יאמר זכיתי ליבי"** (מש' כ, ט) — אין שיכול לומר "חטאתי עוויתי פשעתי" בלא פניות. לכן: **תשובה על התשובה הראשונה** — על "חטאתי" עצמו. **"בשפתיו כבדוני"** (יש' כט, יג) — בתשובה זוכה לכבוד — **"וליבו ריחק ממני"** — גם זו צריכה תשובה.

scholarly.he: סעיף ג. מידת התשובה תמידית — "מי יאמר זיכיתי ליבי" (מש' כ, ט). תשובה על התשובה: "בשפתיו כבדוני וליבו ריחק ממני" (יש' כט, יג).

beginner.en: **"When a person wants to walk in ways of teshuvah, he needs to be **baki b'halachah** (expert in the halachah)."** But the Rebbe says he needs **two kinds of expertise**: **baki b'ratzo** (expert in running-up) and **baki b'shov** (expert in returning-down). Source: **"'Zakka'a man de'ayil v'nafik'"** — 'fortunate is he who enters and exits' (Zohar Vayakhel 213b, Ha'azinu 292a). Then the verse-diagram: **"'Im esak shamayim — sham atah'"** — 'if I ascend to the heavens — You are there' (Tehillim 139:8) — **aspect of enter = baki b'ratzo**. **"'V'atzia Sheol — hinneka'"** — 'if I lay my bed in Sheol — behold You are there' — **aspect of exit = baki b'shov**. **"And this is: 'Ani l'dodi v'dodi li'"** (Shir 6:3) — **'Ani l'dodi'** is *ayil* (enter); **'dodi li'** is *nafik* (exit). **[And this is the sod of the kavanos of Elul]**. And this is the essence of his kavod. And this: **'v'kibadto me'asos derachecha'** (Yeshayahu 58:13) — *derachecha*, plural — entering and exiting both.

intermediate.en: **Baki b'halachah = two bekius: b'ratzo + b'shov.** Source: **"zakka'a man de'ayil v'nafik"** (Zohar Vayak 213b, Haaz 292a). Verse-diagram: **"im esak shamayim sham atah"** = ayil (ratzo); **"v'atzia Sheol hinneka"** = nafik (shov) — Teh 139:8. **"Ani l'dodi v'dodi li"** (Shir 6:3) — same pair. [Sod kavanos of Elul.] **"V'kibadto me'asos derachecha"** (Yesh 58:13) — *derachecha* plural = both directions.
intermediate.he: **בקי בהלכה = שני בקיאויות: ברצוא ובשוב.** מקור: **"זכאה מאן דעייל ונפיק"** (זוהר ויקהל ריג:; האז' רצב.). תרשים פסוק: **"אם אסק שמים שם אתה"** = עייל (רצוא); **"ואציעה שאול הנך"** = נפיק (שוב) — תה' קלט, ח. **"אני לדודי ודודי לי"** (שה"ש ו, ג) — אותו צמד. [סוד כוונות אלול.] **"וכבדתו מעשות דרכיך"** (יש' נח, יג) — *דרכיך* לשון רבים = שני כיוונים.

scholarly.he: סעיף ד. שני בקיאויות — ברצוא ("אם אסק שמים", תה' קלט, ח) ובשוב ("ואציעה שאול"). "זכאה מאן דעייל ונפיק" (זוהר ויקהל ריג:). "אני לדודי ודודי לי" (שה"ש ו, ג). "וכבדתו מעשות דרכיך" (יש' נח, יג).

beginner.en: **"By means of the silence and quietude is made the aspect of **chirik**"** — as brought in Tikkunim (Hakdamah 7). **"'V'sachas raglav ke'ma'aseh livnas hasapir'"** — 'and under His feet like a work of sapphire stone' (Shemos 24:10) — this is **chirik**; and this is the aspect of **"'v'ha'aretz hadom raglai'"** (Yeshayahu 66:1) — 'the earth is My footstool' — **'hadom'** = aspect of **demamah** (silence); and this is the aspect of the **lower point of the form of the alef**. And **the upper point above the alef is the aspect of **keter** — the aspect of **'u'mima'al la'rakia asher al rosham even sapir demus kisse'** (Yechezkel 1:26) — 'and above the firmament above their heads a sapphire stone, the likeness of a throne' — 'that is covered above from the vav in the alef, which is called the firmament' (ibid. Tikkunim). **The point is the throne that is covered** — as in **'bamufla mimcha al tidrosh, u'bamechuseh mimcha al tachkor'"** (Chagigah 13a) — 'do not seek what is beyond you, do not investigate what is hidden from you.' This is **'kvod Elokim haster davar'** — the keter-aspect. **"And the vav within the alef is the **rakia, shamayim, esh u'mayim** — aspect of the **bosheth** (shame) that changed his face..."** — i.e., the connector of the two crowns by the courage of absorbing shame silently.

intermediate.en: **Silence → chirik.** Tik' Hakdamah 7a. **"V'sachas raglav ke'ma'aseh livnas hasapir"** (Shem 24:10) = chirik; **"v'ha'aretz hadom raglai"** (Yesh 66:1) — *hadom* = demamah. Chirik = **lower point of alef**. **Upper point of alef = keter** = **"u'mima'al la'rakia...even sapir demus kisse"** (Yech 1:26); the covered throne = **"bamufla mimcha al tidrosh"** (Chag 13a) = **"kvod Elokim haster davar."** **Vav within alef = rakia** (shamayim, esh u'mayim) — connector through the bosheth of silent shame.
intermediate.he: **שתיקה → חיריק.** תק"ז הקדמה ז.. **"ותחת רגליו כמעשה לבנת הספיר"** (שמ' כד, י) = חיריק; **"והארץ הדום רגלי"** (יש' סו, א) — *הדום* = דממה. חיריק = **נקודה תחתונה של אל"ף**. **נקודה עליונה של אל"ף = כתר** = **"וממעל לרקיע... אבן ספיר דמות כסא"** (יחז' א, כו); הכיסא המתכסה = **"במופלא ממך אל תדרוש"** (חג' יג.) = **"כבוד אלוהים הסתר דבר"**. **וא"ו שבתוך האל"ף = רקיע** (שמים, אש ומים) — המחבר דרך גבורת השתיקה בפני בזיון.

scholarly.he: סעיף ה. חיריק (נק' תחתונה של אל"ף) = "ותחת רגליו" (שמ' כד, י), "והארץ הדום רגלי" (יש' סו, א). נק' עליונה = כתר = "וממעל לרקיע... דמות כסא" (יחז' א, כו); "במופלא ממך" (חג' יג.). וא"ו שבאל"ף = רקיע.

beginner.en: **"And this is the *peirush*: **"Amar Rabba bar bar Chana: once we were walking in the desert and we saw geese whose feathers were dropping from their fatness, and **streams of oil flowed from under them**. I said to them: 'Do I have a share from you in the world to come?' One raised for me a thigh, and one raised for me a wing. When I came before Rabbi Elazar, he said to me: **'Israel will be held accountable for them.'"** (Bava Basra 73b). This is the fourth Rabba bar bar Chana ma'amar decoded in consecutive Torahs (T3, T4, T5, now T6). Every detail — the desert, the fattening geese, the feathers dropping, the streams of oil from underneath, the offering of thigh and wing, and Israel's future accountability — will be the Rebbe's mirror of this Torah's whole structure.

intermediate.en: Fourth Rabba bar bar Chana ma'amar (T3 akrukta, T4 worm, T5 ship-between-fins, T6 geese): **"We were walking in the desert, saw geese whose feathers dropped from their fatness, streams of oil flowing from under them. I asked: do I have a share from you in olam haba? One raised a thigh, one raised a wing. R' Elazar: 'Israel will be held accountable for them'"** (Bava Basra 73b).
intermediate.he: המאמר הרביעי של רבב"ח (תורה ג אקרוקתא; ד שרץ; ה ספינה בין סנפירים; ו אווזים): **"הוינן אזלינן במדברא, וחזינן הני אוזי דשמיטין גדפיהו משומניהו, וקא נגדי נחלי דמשחא מתותיהו. אמינא להו: אית לי מניכו חולקא לעלמא דאתי? חדא דליא לי אטמא, וחדא דליא לי גדפא. כי אתאי לקמיה דר' אלעזר, אמר לי: עתידין ישראל ליתן עליהם את הדין"** (ב"ב עג:).

scholarly.he: ב"ב עג:: המאמר הרביעי — אווזים שומטות נוצות משומנם, נחלי משחא, אטמא וגדפא, "עתידין ישראל ליתן עליהם את הדין" (רבי אלעזר).

beginner.en: **Rashbam's gloss:** **"dishmitin gadfaihu"** — their feathers fell from their great fatness. **"Dilya li gadpa"** — raised the wing for me — a hint: this is your portion for the world-to-come. **"Lisein aleihem es ha'din"** — by their sins Mashiach is delayed, and these geese suffer **tza'ar ba'alei chayim** because of their fat.

intermediate.en: Rashbam: **dishmitin gadfaihu** = feathers fell from fatness; **dilya li gadpa** = raised the wing = hint to olam haba portion; **lisein aleihem es ha'din** = their sins delay Mashiach, geese suffer tza'ar ba'alei chayim.
intermediate.he: רשב"ם: **דשמיטין גדפייהו** = נוצות נפלו מרוב שומן; **דליא לי גדפא** = הרמת כנף, רמז לעוה"ב; **ליתן עליהם את הדין** = חטאי ישראל מעכבים משיח, והאווזים סובלים צב"ח משומנן.

scholarly.he: רשב"ם: דשמיטין גדפייהו—נוצות נושרות; דליא גדפא—רמז חלק לעתיד; ליתן עליהם את הדין—החטאים מעכבים משיח, צער בע"ח לאווזים.

beginner.en: **Peirush**. **"'**She'halach**'** — he went to investigate the good middah of **anavah** (humility), where a person makes himself like a threshing-floor on which all tread"** (cf. Eruvin 54a). **"'**V'ra'ah chachamim**' — and this is the aspect of **geese**, as Chazal said (Berachos 57b): **'one who sees an oh (goose) in a dream should expect chochmah.'"** **"'Dishmitin gadfaihu' — Rashi explains: feathers — this is the aspect of **machlokes and bizyonos** (disputes and disgraces), as it is written: **'ki yinatzu anashim'** (Devarim 25:11) — that they **don't pay attention** to the disputes and disgraces of those who disgrace them, and hear their reproach and don't reply. On account of this silence they are called **chachamim** — for (Avos 3:17): **'syag la'chochmah — shetikah'** ('the fence of wisdom is silence'). **[Because silence is the aspect of keter, because through silence one merits teshuvah, which is the aspect of keter...]** And this is the language of **'shomeit'** — as in **'shamot kol ba'al masheh yado'** (Devarim 15:2) — 'every creditor shall release' — that they don't demand redress for their insult. And this is: **'syag la'chochmah shetikah'** — **syag precisely** — this is keter, which is the aspect of a **syag and g'deir saviv saviv** (fence and boundary all around) that surrounds and crowns and adorns the chochmah."**

intermediate.en: **Peirush**: **"she'halach"** = investigating **anavah** (man as threshing-floor trodden by all; cf. Eruvin 54a). **"V'ra'ah chachamim"** = **geese** (Berachos 57b: "sees a goose in a dream — expect chochmah"). **"Dishmitin gadfaihu"** = **feathers = machlokes/bizyonos** ("ki yinatzu anashim," Dev 25:11); they don't attend to them. Silent → called **chachamim** (Avos 3:17: "syag la'chochmah shetikah"). **"Shomeit"** = "shamot kol ba'al masheh" (Dev 15:2) — release, don't demand redress. **"Syag precisely"** = keter = fence surrounding, crowning, adorning chochmah.
intermediate.he: **פירוש**: **"שהלך"** = לחקור ב**ענוה** (כמדבר לדוש, עיר' נד.). **"וראה חכמים"** = **אווזים** (ברכ' נז:: "רואה אווז בחלום יצפה לחכמה"). **"דשמיטין גדפייהו"** = **נוצות = מחלוקת/בזיונות** ("כי ינצו אנשים", דב' כה, יא); שאינם משגיחים עליהן. שותקין → נקראו **חכמים** (אבות ג:יז: "סייג לחכמה שתיקה"). **"שומט"** = "שמוט כל בעל משה" (דב' טו, ב) — אינו תובע עלבונו. **"סייג דוקא"** = כתר = סייג וגדר סביב, הסובב, מכתיר ומעטיר את החכמה.

scholarly.he: פירוש: שהלך—ענוה (עיר' נד.); אווזים—חכמים (ברכ' נז:); גדפייהו—מחלוקת/בזיונות (דב' כה, יא); השתיקה—סייג־חכמה = כתר (אבות ג:יז); שומט—"שמוט בעל משה" (דב' טו, ב).

beginner.en: **"[Footnote: because through silence one merits teshuvah, which is the aspect of keter, as above. And this is the aspect of **'syag la'chochmah shetikah'**. **'Syag'** precisely — this is the aspect of keter, which is the aspect of **syag and g'deir saviv saviv** that surrounds and crowns and adorns the chochmah. This keter, which is the aspect of syag, is made **from silence**, as above. And this is: **'syag la'chochmah shetikah'**, as above.]"** The Rebbe is insisting: Avos **syag la'chochmah — shetikah** is not saying silence *protects* wisdom from outside; it is saying silence **constructs** the very crown that makes chochmah visible.

intermediate.en: **[Footnote]**: Silence → teshuvah → keter = **syag**. Avos 3:17 "syag la'chochmah shetikah" is not 'silence protects wisdom'; it is 'silence *constructs* the crown that makes chochmah visible.' *Syag* precisely = keter, the fence-saviv-saviv surrounding, crowning, adorning chochmah.
intermediate.he: **[הערה]**: שתיקה → תשובה → כתר = **סייג**. "סייג לחכמה שתיקה" (אבות ג:יז) אינו "שתיקה מגינה על חכמה"; אלא "שתיקה **בונה** את הכתר שמגלה את החכמה." *סייג* דוקא = כתר, הסובב־סביב, מכתיר ומעטיר את החכמה.

scholarly.he: השתיקה בונה את הכתר (הסייג). "סייג לחכמה שתיקה" — הסייג עצמו הוא הכתר שמגלה החכמה.

beginner.en: **"*Peirush* 'mishmanaihu' — from the language: **'shamansa avisa'** ('you grew fat, grew thick,' Devarim 32:15)"** — because they hold themselves in the aspect of **'shamansa avisa'** — *i.e.,* **"on this account they hear their reproach and do not reply, for they do this for the sake of teshuvah on their sins"** — as it is written: **"'va'yishman Yeshurun'** (Devarim 32:15)"** — the Rebbe is hearing the *entire* critical verse **"hashmen lev ha'am hazeh... pen yireh..."** (Yeshayahu 6:10) as actually praise in this register: **teshuvah needs to be in these three conditions — heavy heart (against pride), stopped ears (against lashon hara), closed eyes (against looking where you shouldn't)**. **"'V'nagdi nachalei d'mishcha mitchoseihu'** — by silence they merit **kavod Elokim, which is the aspect of shemen (oil)** — **'ahavta tzedek...al kein mishachacha'** (Tehillim 45:8); **'Melech ha'Kavod'** (Tehillim 24:7). **'Dilya li atma'** — aspect of **'v'ha'aretz hadom raglai'** (chirik, lower point); **'dilya li gadpa'** — **'v'lo yikanef od morecha'** (Yeshayahu 30:20) — upper point.

intermediate.en: **Mishmanaihu** from **"shamansa avisa"** (Dev 32:15) — they hear reproach and don't reply because they are doing teshuvah ("va'yishman Yeshurun"); the three conditions of teshuvah hinted at in "hashmen lev...pen yireh" (Yesh 6:10). **Nachalei d'mishcha** = kavod Elokim = shemen ("al kein mishachacha," Teh 45:8; "Melech ha'Kavod," Teh 24:7). **Dilya atma** = chirik (lower point of alef); **dilya gadpa** = upper point ("v'lo yikanef od morecha," Yesh 30:20).
intermediate.he: **משומניהו** מ**"שמנת עבית"** (דב' לב, טו) — שומע חרפתו ואינו משיב מפני תשובה ("וישמן ישורון"); ג' תנאי התשובה רמוזים ב"השמן לב... פן יראה" (יש' ו, י). **נחלי דמשחא** = כבוד אלוהים = שמן ("על כן משחך", תה' מה, ח; "מלך הכבוד", תה' כד, ז). **דליא אטמא** = חיריק (נק' תחתונה); **דליא גדפא** = נק' עליונה ("ולא יכנף עוד מוריך", יש' ל, כ).

scholarly.he: משומניהו—"שמנת עבית" (דב' לב, טו; יש' ו, י — ג' תנאי תשובה). נחלי דמשחא—כבוד = שמן (תה' מה, ח; כד, ז). אטמא—חיריק; גדפא—נק' עליונה (יש' ל, כ).

beginner.en: **"*Peirush*: **"'Yadbir amim tachteinu u'leumim tachas ragleinu'"** (Tehillim 47:4) — **this is the aspect of chirik, the lower point of the alef, which is the aspect of 'v'sachas raglav,' 'v'ha'aretz hadom raglai.'"** **"'Yivchar lanu es nachlaseinu'** — this is the aspect of **Moshe**, the upper point of the alef, aspect of **'u'mima'al la'rakia demus kisse'** — and his throne is like the sun. **'Pnei Moshe k'pnei chamah'** (Bava Basra 75a). As Chazal said (Zevachim 119a): **'R' Shimon says: nachalah this is Shiloh'** — and **'Shiloh da Moshe'** (Zohar Bereshis 25b; Tikkun 21). **"'Es ge'on Yaakov'** — this is the aspect of the **vav within the alef**, the aspect of **ohel, aspect of ohr** — that **Moshe illuminates to Yehoshua**, as it is written (Bereshis 25:27): **'v'Yaakov ish tam yoshev ohalim'**. And this is the aspect of (Sanhedrin 20a): **'three mitzvos were commanded to Israel upon entering the land...'** (developed below).

intermediate.en: **"Yadbir amim tachteinu"** (Teh 47:4) = chirik/lower point. **"Yivchar lanu nachlaseinu"** = **Moshe** = upper point (**"u'mima'al la'rakia demus kisse,"** his throne like the sun; "pnei Moshe k'pnei chamah," BB 75a). **"Nachalah zo Shiloh"** (R' Shimon, Zev 119a) = **Shiloh da Moshe** (Zohar Ber 25b; Tik 21). **"Es ge'on Yaakov"** = **vav within alef**, ohel/ohr by which Moshe illuminates Yehoshua ("v'Yaakov ish tam yoshev ohalim," Ber 25:27; cf. Sanh 20a).
intermediate.he: **"ידבר עמים תחתינו"** (תה' מז, ד) = חיריק/נק' תחתונה. **"יבחר לנו את נחלתנו"** = **משה** = נק' עליונה (**"וממעל לרקיע דמות כסא"**; "פני משה כפני חמה", ב"ב עה.). **"נחלה זו שילה"** (ר' שמעון, זב' קיט.) = **שילה דא משה** (זוהר בר' כה:; תיקון כא). **"את גאון יעקב"** = **וא"ו שבאל"ף**, אוהל/אור שבו משה מאיר ליהושע ("ויעקב איש תם יושב אוהלים", בר' כה, כז; עיין סנה' כ.).

scholarly.he: "ידבר עמים תחתינו" (תה' מז, ד) — חיריק. "יבחר לנו" — משה (פני משה כחמה, ב"ב עה.; "נחלה זו שילה"=משה, זב' קיט.; זוה"ק בר' כה:). "גאון יעקב"—ואו שבאל"ף, אוהל/אור (בר' כה, כז; סנה' כ.).

beginner.en: **"[From siman 4 until here, language of our Rebbe, zichrono livrachah]."** Reb Nosson inserts an editorial marker: sections 4 through the point just reached were recorded in the Rebbe's own words; what follows is his transcriptional elaboration. **[This connects to sod kavanos of Elul: the Rebbe heard in it the **derech b'yam** (way in the sea) — **"hanosen ba'yam derech"** (Yeshayahu 43:16) — that one must illuminate the 'way' within the sea; and the way is the **yamin** which in milui ascends to derech with three letters, that is twice...]**

intermediate.en: Reb Nosson's editorial marker: **"from siman 4 to here — Rebbe's own words."** The rest is elaboration. [Connection to Elul kavanos: **"hanosen ba'yam derech"** (Yesh 43:16) — derech within the sea — *yamin* in milui ascends to derech.]
intermediate.he: הערת ר' נתן: **"מסימן ד' עד כאן לשון רבנו זכרונו לברכה"**. השאר — ביאורו. [קישור לכוונות אלול: **"הנותן בים דרך"** (יש' מג, טז) — דרך בתוך הים — *ימין* במילוי עולה דרך.]

scholarly.he: הערת ר' נתן: "מסימן ד' עד כאן לשון רבנו". קישור לכוונות אלול ("הנותן בים דרך", יש' מג, טז).

beginner.en: **Peirush ha'pasuk:** **"'Vayomer Hashem el Moshe, Kra es Yehoshua'** — **Moshe is the upper point, Yehoshua is the lower point."** **"'V'hisyatzvu ba'ohel'** — this is the aspect of the **rakia**, the vav within the alef."** **"'Va'atzavenu'** — because Moshe needed at that moment to transmit everything to Yehoshua, **'v'ein shilton b'yom ha'maves'** (Kohelet 8:8) — 'there is no dominion on the day of death' — because at the moment of the tzaddik's passing, he has no more rulership and power to illuminate to Yehoshua. Therefore **the verse is precise: 'va'atzavenu' — I, **Myself** — because the dominion has returned to the Holy One Himself."** This is the heart of the verse: Moshe's transmission is *not* the crucial handoff; the crucial moment is Hashem **Himself** stepping in to command Yehoshua directly, because the tzaddik has just withdrawn.

intermediate.en: **Peirush ha'pasuk:** **"Vayomer Hashem el Moshe, kra es Yehoshua"** — Moshe = upper point; Yehoshua = lower point. **"V'hisyatzvu ba'ohel"** = rakia = vav within alef. **"Va'atzavenu"** = Moshe needed to transmit — but **"ein shilton b'yom ha'maves"** (Koh 8:8) — at tzaddik's petirah he loses power to illuminate Yehoshua; hence **precisely** **va'atzavenu — "I Myself,"** since dominion reverted to Hashem Himself.
intermediate.he: **פירוש הפסוק:** **"ויאמר ה' אל משה, קרא את יהושע"** — משה = נק' עליונה; יהושע = נק' תחתונה. **"והתיצבו באוהל"** = רקיע = וא"ו שבאל"ף. **"ואצונו"** = משה היה צריך למסור — אלא **"אין שלטון ביום המוות"** (קה' ח, ח) — בשעת הסתלקות הצדיק אין לו כוח להאיר ליהושע; לכן דוקא **ואצונו — "אני בעצמי"**, כי חזרה הממשלה להקב"ה.

scholarly.he: פירוש הפסוק: משה=נק' עליונה; יהושע=תחתונה; והתיצבו באוהל=רקיע (וא"ו שבאל"ף); "ואצונו"—"אני בעצמי" (כי "אין שלטון ביום המוות", קה' ח, ח—בשעת הסתלקות אין כוח להאיר), חזרת הממשלה להקב"ה.

beginner.en:
**"And the general principle of the entire matter is contained in the form of the alef — upper point, lower point, and vav."** The Rebbe lands on the three mitzvos that Chazal said Israel was commanded upon entering the Land: **to uproot Amalek, to build the Beis ha'Bechirah, and to appoint a king** (Sanhedrin 20b). Each maps precisely: **uprooting Amalek = Yehoshua = the lower point** — it was Yehoshua who was commanded *"tze hilachem ba'Amalek"* — go out and fight Amalek (Shemos 17:9; cf. Zohar Beshalach 65b); **building the Beis ha'Bechirah = Moshe = the upper point** — because Chazal say *"one who has da'as in him, it is as if the Beis ha'Mikdash was built in his days"* (Berachos 33a), and Moshe is the entire aspect of da'as; **appointing a king = the rakia = the vav within the alef**, connecting the two points.

Then the Rebbe adds the kabbalistic precision that unifies everything. The **two bekius-es** (the two expertises established above) map onto two Divine Names in their milui (expanded letter-spelling): **Bekius b'ratzo** (expertise in running upward) draws from **Ehyeh in milui KaSA** — spelled out in full = 161 = the **segol = the upper point of the alef** ("im esak shamayim — sham atah," Tehillim 139:8: the letters of *esak* carry this very value). **Bekius b'shov** (expertise in returning downward) draws from **Havayah in milui SaG** — the SaG filling = 63 = the **chirik = the lower point of the alef** ("v'atzia Sheol — hinneka": even in the lowest descent, Name SaG sustains you).

Now the magnificent convergence: **161 + 63 = 224 = the gematria of derech (דרך — way)**. This is the *way of teshuvah* — formed when both the upper and lower points of the alef are active together. The **yamin** (right hand of Hashem) extends to receive the penitent at this very value, as above.

Finally, the Rebbe ties back to the opening theme of the whole Torah. **Teshuvah on teshuvah** maps onto the same two alef-points: the **first teshuvah = dom l'Hashem** (the silence, the turning of *dam* to *dom*) = the **lower point = chirik = SaG = 63**. The **second teshuvah** (done on the first teshuvah itself) = **keter = the upper point = segol = 161**. The Torah that opened with the distinction between kavod melachim and kavod Elokim ends by revealing that both teshuvos, and both directions of movement in Hashem's service, are encoded in the form of the letter alef.

intermediate.en:
**Alef = entire structure.** Three mitzvos before Eretz Yisrael (Sanh 20b): **(1) uproot Amalek = Yehoshua = lower point** ("tze hilachem ba'Amalek," Shem 17:9; Zohar Besh 65b); **(2) build Beis HaMikdash = Moshe = upper point** (Ber 33a: "one with da'as — Mikdash built in his days"); **(3) appoint king = rakia = vav in alef.**

**Kavanos of the two bekius-es**: bekius b'ratzo = **Ehyeh milui KaSA** (קס"א=161) = segol = upper point ("im esak shamayim" = 161); bekius b'shov = **Havayah milui SaG** (ס"ג=63) = chirik = lower point ("v'atzia Sheol hinneka"). **161+63=224=derech** (דרך) = way of teshuvah = yamin of Hashem extended to receive teshuvah.

**Teshuvah on teshuvah through the alef**: first teshuvah = dom l'Hashem = **chirik** (63=SaG); second teshuvah = keter = **segol** (161=KaSA). The entire Torah converges in the alef.
intermediate.he:
**האל"ף = כל המבנה.** ג' מצוות (סנה' כ.): **(1) כריתת עמלק = יהושע = נק' תחתונה** ("צא הלחם בעמלק", שמ' יז, ט; זוהר בשלח סה:); **(2) בניין בית הבחירה = משה = נק' עליונה** (ברכ' לג.: "מי שיש בו דעה, כאילו נבנה המקדש בימיו"); **(3) מינוי מלך = רקיע = וא"ו שבאל"ף.**

**כוונות שני הבקיאויות**: בקי ברצוא = **אהיה מילוי קס"א** (=161) = שגול = נק' עליונה ("אם אסק שמים" = 161); בקי בשוב = **הוי"ה מילוי ס"ג** (=63) = חיריק = נק' תחתונה ("ואציעה שאול הנך"). **161+63=224=דרך** (התשובה) = ימין ה' הנטויה לקבל תשובתו.

**תשובה על תשובה דרך האל"ף**: תשובה ראשונה = דום לה' = **חיריק** (63=ס"ג); שניה (על הראשונה) = כתר = **שגול** (161=קס"א). כל בניין התורה מתכנס בצורת האל"ף.

scholarly.he: סעיף ח. כל הענין באל"ף. ג' מצוות (סנה' כ.): (1) עמלק=יהושע=נק' תחתונה (שמ' יז, ט; זוהר בשלח סה:); (2) מקדש=משה=נק' עליונה (ברכ' לג.); (3) מלך=רקיע=וא"ו. כוונות: בקי ברצוא=אהיה מילוי קס"א (=161)=שגול=נק' עליונה; בקי בשוב=הוי"ה מילוי ס"ג (=63)=חיריק=נק' תחתונה. 161+63=224=דרך=ימין ה'. תשובה על תשובה: ראשונה=חיריק (63); שניה=כתר=שגול (161).

beginner.en: **The main point:** **"By means of a person, when he is at a very low level — and nevertheless strengthens himself and believes that even *there* there is still hope for him, because even there Hashem is found — aspect of **'v'atzia Sheol hinneka'** — he draws upon himself the kedushah from the **holy Name Havayah in milui SaG**, which sustains all those who have retreated from His holiness, to hold them up lest they fall entirely, chas v'shalom. And this is the **bekius b'shov** — the aspect of the holy Name **YaBok** (י-ב-ק) — the aspect of **Name SaG**."** And: **"When a person merits to come to some level in the upper kedushah, and even so does not stand there, but strengthens himself to rise more and more — he draws upon himself the kedushah from the **holy Name E-hyeh in milui KaSA (קס"א)** — the aspect of **bekius b'ratzo**."** The precise kavanos: Havayah-SaG (ס"ג = 63) catches you when you fall; Ehyeh-KaSA (קס"א = 161) drives you upward when you've already arrived. Man's movement governs which Name illuminates him.

intermediate.en: **Main point**: at the lowest level, strengthen yourself and believe Hashem is there too ("v'atzia Sheol hinneka") → draw kedushah from **Havayah milui SaG** (ס"ג = 63) = **bekius b'shov** = aspect of **YaBok**. At the highest level, don't stop — drive higher → draw from **Ehyeh milui KaSA** (קס"א = 161) = **bekius b'ratzo**. SaG catches falls; KaSA drives ascent.
intermediate.he: **עיקר**: במדרגה התחתונה מאוד, מתחזק ומאמין שגם שם ה' ("ואציעה שאול הנך") → ממשיך קדושה משם **הויה במילוי ס"ג** (=63) = **בקי בשוב** = שם **יב"ק**. במדרגה עליונה, לא לעמוד — להתעלות → ממשיך משם **אהיה במילוי קס"א** (=161) = **בקי ברצוא**. ס"ג תופס בנפילה; קס"א דוחף בעלייה.

scholarly.he: עיקר — במדרגה תחתונה: הויה במילוי ס"ג (=63), בקי בשוב, שם יב"ק ("ואציעה שאול הנך"). במדרגה עליונה: אהיה במילוי קס"א (=161), בקי ברצוא.

beginner.en: The Rebbe returns to the beginning. **"And behold, as explained above, by means of silence and quietude when one is silent to his friend when disgraced, by this he merits to teshuvah, which is the aspect of keter as above"** — **"because 'syag la'chochmah shetikah,' as above."** Practical: **"One must be very careful to judge every man favorably — and even those who dispute him and disgrace him — he must judge them favorably and be silent to them — and by this is made the aspect of keter."** The concluding mashal, from Midrash: **"A man found his friend making a crown. He asked: 'For whom?' He said: 'For the king.' He said: 'Since it is for the need of the king, every precious stone you find, set it into it'"** (Vayikra Rabbah 2). And: **"Every Jew is an aspect of keter for Hashem — and he must insert into it every kind of precious stone he can find — i.e., he must judge every man favorably."** The Torah that opened with the kavod-of-kings against the kavod-of-Elokim ends by turning **every Jew** into a crown-maker for the King, soldered with the silence of each unreturned insult.

intermediate.en: **Conclusion**: silence → teshuvah → keter ("syag la'chochmah shetikah"). Practical: **dan l'kaf zechus every man** — even his disputants and insulters — silently. Mashal (Vayikra Rabbah 2): a man making a crown — "since it's for the king, every precious stone you find, set it in." Every Jew = aspect of keter for Hashem; insert every precious stone (= judge every man favorably). The Torah that opened with kavod-melachim vs kavod-Elokim ends by making every Jew a crown-maker for the King, soldered by silent insults.
intermediate.he: **סיום**: שתיקה → תשובה → כתר ("סייג לחכמה שתיקה"). מעשי: **לדון לכף זכות את כל אדם** — אף חולקיו ומבזיו — בשתיקה. משל (ויק"ר ב): אחד מוצא את חברו עושה כתר — "בשביל המלך? כל אבן טובה שתמצא תקבענו בו." כל יהודי = בחינת כתר להשי"ת; יכניס כל אבן טובה (= לדון כ"א לכ"ז). התורה שפתחה בכבוד־מלכים לעומת כבוד־אלוהים חותמת בהפיכת כל יהודי לעושה־כתר למלך, המחושל בשתיקות הלא־נענות.

scholarly.he: סיום: שתיקה → תשובה → כתר. לדון כל אדם לכף זכות (אף חולקים ומבזים). משל ויק"ר ב: "בשביל המלך? כל אבן טובה תקבענו בו." כל יהודי בחינת כתר להשי"ת, והמעטרו באבנים טובות של דן לכף זכות.
